summary.text: Jennifer Davis is the Republican nominee for Illinois's 8th District and a first-time candidate for federal office. She co-founded the software company Davisware and later launched BExponential, and describes herself as a political outsider. She won the March 2026 Republican primary and, in her Ballotpedia survey, names affordability, small-business support and cybersecurity as her main messages.

paragraphs.text: Describes herself as having co-founded the service-technology software company Davisware with her husband, Dan, at age 17, and growing it into a global company.

According to her Ballotpedia survey, she guided Davisware through the pandemic and a partnership with Serent Capital, then launched BExponential, a business to help women thrive personally and professionally.
Wrote a book, "Living Exponentially in Life and Business."
Describes herself as a mother of ten, a coach of dozens of youth teams, and a community servant with rural values of hard work, faith and family.
Won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary with 51.4% of the vote, ahead of Mark Rice (40.2%), Kevin Ake and Herbert Hebein.
Her Ballotpedia survey lists affordability, support for small businesses and entrepreneurs, and a proposed "Digital Dome" cyber defense program among her key messages.
